tagline: Leading Spanish insurance group with global presence
hero_kpi_rationale: Exceptional 42.9% net income growth, demonstrating substantial improvement in profitability driven by better claims experience and significant investment gains.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from insurance and investment activities.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue amounts to €50.4 billion in 2024, up 4.2% compared to 2023, driven by organic growth and reinsurance.
kpis.signal: Stable customer portfolio growth and sound premium management.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses, taxes, and minority interests.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders reaches €967.5 million in 2024, a significant increase from €677.2 million in 2023.
kpis.signal: Strong net income growth driven by improved claims experience and investment gains.

kpis.name: Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Combined ratio of claims and acquisition expenses divided by premiums, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The combined ratio improves to 86.6% in 2024, compared to 88.4% in 2023 (inverse of combined gross margin), reflecting more efficient claims and cost management.
kpis.signal: Improved combined ratio due to better risk selection and claims management.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reaches 8.1% in 2024, up from 6.2% in 2023, supported by optimization of general and administrative expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operating margin driven by cost discipline.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Expenditures on tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amount to €300 million in 2024, a slight increase, primarily directed toward information systems.
kpis.signal: Modest capex, consistent with a low capital-intensive business model.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: The group employs 54,700 people as of end-2024, down 0.6% compared to 2023, despite targeted digital hiring.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction, indicating process optimization.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of €0.1671 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of €1.183 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 104.5% in the latest year.

risks.title: Mortality and longevity risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the section (first paragraph), moderate language ('tend to take place') but cumulative long-term impact. Stable compared to N-1. Industrial category weighs less than regulatory/cyber but critical for life insurer.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on contracts
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in early-middle of section, direct language ('This risk is more important'), impact quantified in sensitivity tables (7.1% OCI 2024). Stable. Capital category carries high weight for insurer.

risks.title: Early contract surrender risk
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle of section, moderate language ('risk that contracts are surrendered'), impact mitigated by penalties. Stable. Classic operational risk for life insurer, mitigated by contractual mechanisms.

risks.title: Non-life extreme claims risk
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle of section, strong language ('extreme weather phenomena', 'natural disasters'), impact quantified (Ultimate loss -1% = 2.1% P&L 2024). Stable but increasing climate trend. Industrial category critical for non-life insurer.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Positioned in middle-to-late section, moderate language ('would affect'), indirect impact via cash flows. Stable. Capital category carries high weight but group benefits from geographic diversification.

risks.title: Asset-liability mismatch risk
risks.score_rationale: Positioned at end of technical section, moderate language ('aims to maintain exposure'), impact controlled by ALM. Stable. Well-managed operational risk due to group's explicit ALM policy.

ai_positioning.summary: Mapfre adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, primarily using it for claims automation and risk analysis. The focus is on operational efficiency rather than disruptive innovation.
